notes: SCOPE/SOURCES: FY2006-FY2012 annual data from Ritchie Bros. Form 40-F filings (Exhibit 2/99.2 = audited consolidated FS, Exhibit 3/99.3 = MD&A; Exhibit 1 = AIF). Per spec, each year uses the latest 40-F presenting it: 2006 IS/CF from FY2008 40-F (3-yr comparatives), 2006 BS from FY2007 40-F; 2007 IS/CF/BS from FY2008 40-F (BS also in FY2009); 2008 IS/CF from FY2010 40-F, 2008 BS from FY2009 40-F; 2009 from FY2010 40-F; 2010 from FY2011 40-F (IFRS-restated); 2011 from FY2012 40-F; 2012 from FY2013 40-F. All $ in USD millions converted from $000s.

BASIS (1) - Canadian GAAP FY2006-FY2010: statements were prepared under Canadian GAAP, reported in US dollars. FY2006-FY2008 basis note: Cdn GAAP 'except as disclosed ... also comply, in all material respects, with US GAAP'; FY2009-FY2010 note: Cdn GAAP 'differs in certain material respects' from US GAAP (reconciliation note 13/14). Published US GAAP reconciliation: NI identical in 2006, 2007, 2009, 2010; ONLY 2008 differs: US GAAP NI $86.516m (EPS 0.83 basic / 0.82 diluted) vs Cdn GAAP $101.400m because the $14.884m cumulative translation adjustment released to income on settlement of intercompany loans (inside the 2008 FX gain of $11.656m) stays in OCI under US GAAP. US GAAP BS differences: 2008 sale-leaseback of new HQ under construction -> US GAAP capital assets $474.720m and AP/accrued $105.192m (Cdn $453.642m / $84.114m); retained earnings under US GAAP lower by $14.884m from 2008 on (2008 342.961; 2009 396.442; 2010 419.089) with AOCI higher by the same amount. Sources: FY2008 40-F Ex.2 note 13, FY2009 Ex.2 note 14, FY2010 Ex.2 note 13.

BASIS (1b) - IFRS FY2011-FY2013: Ritchie Bros adopted IFRS effective 2011 with transition date Jan 1, 2010; 2010 comparatives were restated to IFRS in the FY2011 40-F (used here). IFRS 2010 vs Cdn GAAP 2010: SG&A +$0.488m (share-based payment graded vesting), deferred tax -$0.250m, NI $65.675m vs $65.913m; EPS unchanged 0.62. Balance sheet: CTA reset to nil (retained earnings +$16.959m, FCTR -$16.959m), APIC +$2.404m, DTA +$1.951m, investment property ($8.246m) split out of PP&E, assets held for sale and loan receivable re-presented; total assets $872.558m vs $870.818m. Opening IFRS BS at Jan 1, 2010 (i.e. restated Dec 31, 2009): total assets $859.488m, equity $546.078m, current borrowings $19.326m (incl. $14.257m reclassified from non-current) - the 2009 BS here is kept on the Cdn GAAP basis for consistency with the 2009 IS. CF: IFRS presents interest paid and income taxes paid as separate CFO lines; CFO totals unchanged.

BASIS (1c) - US GAAP for later years: the company moved to US GAAP in its FY2015 10-K, restating 2013-2014 fully and giving only SELECTED US GAAP data for 2011-2012 (FY2015 10-K Item 6): 2012 revenues 437.955, operating income 116.714 (IFRS EBIT 120.039 - US GAAP operating income includes items such as gain/loss on disposition, impairment, FX), pretax 112.015, NI attributable to stockholders 80.593 (IFRS 79.551), EPS 0.76/0.75, total assets 1,132.428, contingently redeemable NCI 3.504, stockholders' equity 653.084, working capital 96.180; 2011 revenues 396.099, operating income 106.988, pretax 108.015, NI attributable 76.834 (IFRS 76.633), EPS 0.72/0.72, total assets 966.162, redeemable NCI 0.960, equity 615.867, LTD 133.881, working capital 63.296. Full US GAAP statements for 2006-2012 do not exist; values in 'is'/'bs'/'cf' for 2011-2012 remain IFRS from the 40-Fs. URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1046102/000127956916002775/v432024_10k.htm

RESTATEMENT (2) - 2008 reclassification (FY2008 40-F, applied to 2007 and 2006 comparatives): interest income moved out of auction revenues into other income; auction advertising and documentation fees moved from an offset of direct expenses into auction revenues; foreign exchange gains/losses moved out of G&A into a separate 'Foreign exchange gain (loss)' line. No NI impact. Originally reported -> restated: 2006 auction revenues 261.040 -> 257.857, direct expenses 36.976 -> 40.457, G&A 118.165 -> 117.714, earnings from operations 90.882 -> 84.669; 2007 auction revenues 315.231 -> 311.906, direct 42.413 -> 46.481, G&A 142.014 -> 144.816, EBIT 111.387 -> 101.192. Geographic revenue also restated (2006 US 157.236 -> 155.558 etc.). Values here are the restated figures. 2006 CF also re-presented in FY2008 40-F (FX loss shown as non-cash item, 'Other' working-capital line changed); CFO total unchanged 65.639.

RESTATEMENT (2b) - 3-for-1 stock split effective April 24, 2008: all share counts / EPS / DPS for 2006-2007 here are split-adjusted from the FY2008 40-F (originally 2006 EPS 1.66/1.64, shares 34.546m; 2007 EPS 2.19/2.17, shares 34.755m; DPS 0.78 / 0.90). The 2006 adjusted EPS (1.61) is pre-split - see adj_ni note.

RESTATEMENT (2c) - FY2013 40-F re-presented 2012 with a non-controlling interest (51%-owned Ritchie Bros. Financial Services): NI attributable to parent 79.551, NCI -0.005; retained earnings 510.491 (orig. 510.222), FCTR 0.533 (orig. 0.535), NCI -0.267; total equity unchanged 656.531. Dec 31, 2011 opening RE re-presented to 480.982 and NCI -0.264 (FY2013 SOCE) - 2011 BS here is as in FY2012 40-F (RE 480.718, no NCI line). 2012 adjusted NI restated from 82.550 (FY2012 MD&A, from total NI) to 82.555 (FY2013 MD&A, attributable to parent).

IS PRESENTATION: total_rev = 'Auction revenues' (2006-2012; renamed 'Revenues' from FY2013) and is a NET agency revenue: commissions + fees + NET profit on inventory sales; service_rev set equal to total_rev; no gross inventory revenue line (inv_sales_rev/cost_inventory omitted). Gross inventory sales disclosed in notes only for 2011-2012 (ops.inv_sales_gross_memo / inv_cost_gross_memo: 2011 820.312/763.121; 2012 795.397/749.160; net 57.191 / 46.237 included in commissions). comm_rev/fee_rev ('auction commissions'/'auction fees') disclosed only from the FY2011 FS (2010-2012); internet/proxy fees were folded into a new expanded administrative fee from July 1, 2011. cost_services = 'Direct expenses'. sga = 'General and administrative' (Cdn GAAP 2006-2009, incl. stock comp) / IFRS SG&A excluding depreciation & amortization (2010-2012; the IFRS IS line 'Selling, general and administrative expenses' INCLUDES D&A: 2010 218.833, 2011 244.343, 2012 268.229). op_income = 'Earnings from operations' = revenue - direct - G&A/SG&A - D&A; gain on disposition of PP&E, FX, other income are presented BELOW earnings from operations in all years (so gain_disp_ppe is non-operating here). interest_exp = 'Interest expense'/'Finance costs'; interest_income = 'Interest income'/'Finance income'. other_income = 'Other'. 2012 da = depreciation 39.177 + amortization of intangibles 1.961.

2012 impairment ($2.172m net impairment of former Statesville NC site) appears as a separate non-cash item in the CF but is NOT a separate IS line (embedded in other income/expense); not put in is.impairment to avoid double count. MD&A: 2012 'other expenses of $4.7 million related to disposition and write-down of auction sites' (Olympia loss 1.946, Statesville 2.172, London ON 0.632).
2010 weighted basic shares: Cdn GAAP IS face (FY2010 40-F) shows 105,609,042 while the EPS note and IFRS FY2011 statements show 105,521,960; the latter is used.

DPS: 'Cash dividends declared per share' in the MD&A selected data is on a cash-paid-in-year basis (includes prior year Q4 dividend paid in Q1; excludes current Q4 declared in January) per FY2011/FY2012 MD&A footnotes. 2011 quarterly: final 2010 $0.105 + Q1 0.105 + Q2 0.1125 + Q3 0.1125 = 0.435 (published 0.44). Q4-2011 $0.1125 declared Jan 20 2012; Q4-2012 $0.1225 declared Jan 21 2013. FY2015 10-K US GAAP selected data shows the same 0.44 (2011) and 0.47 (2012).

BS mapping: other_current = prepaid expenses & deposits + other current assets + current future income tax asset (Cdn GAAP) / + current portion of loan receivable (IFRS). other_noncurrent = other assets (Cdn GAAP; 2009 includes note receivable 5.131, assets held for sale 3.675, LT prepaids) / investment property + loan receivable + other non-current assets (IFRS). 2006 trade_other_liab includes $0.851m current future income tax liability. st_debt = 'Short-term debt' (Cdn GAAP) / 'Current borrowings' (IFRS, short-term revolver draws). current_ltd = current portion of long-term debt (2006-2008). Cdn GAAP AOCI = foreign currency translation adjustment; IFRS = foreign currency translation reserve.

CF mapping: other_noncash = foreign exchange loss (gain) non-cash adjustment. chg_wc for IFRS years (2010-2012) = changes in non-cash working capital PLUS the separate 'Interest paid' and 'Income taxes paid' lines (IFRS working-capital lines add back current tax / interest expense, so the sum is comparable to the Cdn GAAP working-capital total: 2010 IFRS -69.205 equals the Cdn GAAP sum). st_debt_net = issuance less repayment of short-term debt/borrowings. other_investing = decrease (increase) in other assets (2012: proceeds from loan receivable/other assets 0.577 + other 0.161, per FY2013 presentation). 2010 CF from FY2011 IFRS (sbc 3.392 vs Cdn GAAP 2.904; deferred tax 2.691 vs 2.941). Cash basis = cash and cash equivalents (no restricted cash in this era).

GROSS AUCTION PROCEEDS (3) - ops.gtv: labelled 'gross auction sales' in the FY2006 MD&A and 'gross auction proceeds' from FY2007. Definition: 'the total proceeds from all items sold at our auctions' - i.e. the gross hammer value of all lots sold (consigned items under straight commission and guarantee contracts plus items owned as inventory), before commissions/fees; buyer fees are not included; it is not revenue. FY2013 MD&A broadened wording to 'all items sold at our auctions and online marketplaces' (EquipmentOne), while showing 2012 at the same 3,907.991 as the FY2012 MD&A. Neither MD&A states explicitly whether AssetNation/EquipmentOne online-marketplace sales (acquired May 15, 2012) are in 2012 GAP; since 2012 GAP was not revised, treat the 2012 figure as on the same basis in both filings.

AUCTION REVENUE RATE (ops.auction_revenue_rate, fraction) = auction revenues / GAP as published: 2007 9.79% (FY2008 MD&A, on reclassified revenues; originally 9.89%), 2008 9.95%, 2009 10.80%, 2010 10.90%, 2011 10.66%, 2012 11.21%. 2006 published only on the pre-2008 revenue classification: 9.59% (kept as auction_revenue_rate_orig_basis); implied on restated revenues 257.857/2,721.023 = 9.48% (not published).

LOTS (ops.lots_total, thousands): industrial-auction lots only, from MD&A narrative: 2009 ~283,000; 2010 ~277,000; 2011 ~268,500; 2012 ~287,000 (FY2012 MD&A key metric table). Not published for 2006-2008 (2009 MD&A says +12% vs 2008, implying ~253k in 2008 - not used). num_auctions_industrial/agricultural from MD&A narrative (2009: 195/132; 2010: 230/106).
acq_revenue_contribution 2012 = 9.781 = EquipmentOne segment revenues (AssetNation acquired May 15, 2012; ~8 months), from FY2013 40-F segment note.

ADJUSTED NET EARNINGS: 2006 - no formal 'adjusted net earnings' measure; MD&A says NI would have been $56.2m ($1.61 diluted, pre-split) excluding the $1.589m pre-tax ($0.953m after-tax) net effect of a $1.812m gain on Florida excess property less a $0.223m write-down of Texas land. 2007 - FY2007 MD&A published no adjusted figure; the FY2008 MD&A introduced 'adjusted net earnings' and gave 2007 = $71.890m ($0.68). 2008-2011 formal reconciliations ('net earnings excluding after-tax effects of sales of excess properties and significant FX gains/losses on financing activities'). 2012: 'excess property sales and other non-recurring items' (published as one after-tax line 3.004; pretax components from footnotes, tax effect derived). Category 'OTHER' used for 'Net foreign exchange impact on financing transactions'. 2010 values are the IFRS-restated ones (FY2011 MD&A, 64.919); original Cdn GAAP 65.157.

EBITDA: no EBITDA or adjusted EBITDA published for 2006-2010. FY2012 MD&A introduced 'EBITDA Margin' (EBITDA = earnings from operations + D&A, / auction revenues): 2012 36.8%, 2011 36.9% (2012 reconfirmed in FY2013 MD&A). Dollar EBITDA was not published - adj_ebitda.ebitda_calc_company_def is computed per the company definition (2011 146.120; 2012 161.177) and reproduces the published margins. No adjusted EBITDA in this period.
Q4 / quarterly data not extracted (annual only per task). Quarterly GAP/revenue/NI tables exist in each MD&A.
